verified_facts.text: Eden Roc Cap Cana is a secluded property in the exclusive community of Cap Cana at the eastern tip of the Dominican Republic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Eden Roc Cap Cana is a unique and secluded property nestled in the exclusive community of Cap Cana at the eastern tip of the Dominican Republic.

verified_facts.text: Eden Roc Cap Cana is a Relais & Chateaux member hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Eden Roc Cap Cana is the Dominican Republic’s only Relais & Châteaux member hotel.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two distinct areas: an in-land Boutique Suite segment and the Eden Roc Beach Club, about 300 meters apart.
verified_facts.excerpt: Eden Roc Cap Cana presents two distinct resort areas: the in-land Boutique Suite segment, located at a 300-meter distance from the Beach Club

verified_facts.text: The Luxury Pool suites have a private swimming pool and a covered gazebo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private swimming pool and covered gazebo

verified_facts.text: The Oceanfront Bungalows provide complete privacy.
verified_facts.excerpt: our unique Oceanfront Bungalows provide complete privacy

verified_facts.text: Suites come with butler service and personalized concierge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Butler Service & Personalized Concierge

verified_facts.text: The Eden Roc Beach Club has a Blue Flag-certified private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a Blue Flag-certified private beach, the Club provides an intimate setting to connect with loved ones, new friends and yourself.

verified_facts.text: The Koko Kid's Club sits on a lagoon and is designed like a tree house.
verified_facts.excerpt: Koko Kid’s Club, located on a stunning lagoon and designed like tree house

verified_facts.text: Young guests can kayak from the kids club's man-made beach on the lagoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: mini guests can even kayak from the club’s man made ‘beach’ on the lagoon

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the spa entrance at the end of an open-air breezeway flanked by tropical ferns and towering trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the end of an open-air breezeway flanked by tropical ferns and towering trees stands the entrance to the stunning spa.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says verdant living walls and soft color palettes give the spa a calm, lush feel.
verified_facts.excerpt: verdant living walls and soft color palettes create a calm, lush vibe

verified_facts.text: The Punta Espada Golf Course was designed by Jack Nicklaus and all 18 holes have a view to the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Punta Espada Golf Course- designed and signed by Jack Nicklaus, It incorporates all the paradise- like characteristics of Cap Cana throughout the 18 holes, all of which have an extraordinary view to the sea

verified_facts.text: The Punta Espada golf course is five minutes away from Eden Roc.
verified_facts.excerpt: 5 min. away from Eden Roc at Cap Cana

verified_facts.text: Exercise classes include yoga sessions by the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our exercise wellness classes range from high-intensity HIIT classes, to peaceful yoga sessions by the beach, to dancing classes.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a touch of the Italian and French Rivieras.
verified_facts.excerpt: Eden Roc at Cap Cana is a collection of luxury suites in a dreamy setting, with a touch of the Italian and French Rivieras

verified_facts.text: Riva Bar is inspired by the Riva Aquarama boat and has live piano music.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live piano music and views of the stunning main pool and lush gardens enhance the spirit of care-free days spent along the Côte d’Azur.

verified_facts.text: La Palapa sits on an oceanfront point with seating available over the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: making the most of its beachside location with seating available over the water

verified_facts.text: The resort is pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet friendly

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes bath amenities by Acqua di Parma in the accommodations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring bath amenities by Acqua di Parma, spa robes and slippers, rain shower heads, and dedicated butler service, the accommodations pamper your stay.

verified_facts.text: Eden Roc Cap Cana is ideal for families as well as couples.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideal for families as well as couples

verified_facts.text: Eden Roc Cap Cana appears in Condé Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards 2026.
